metadata.description: Deploys a Microsoft Sentinel workspace pre-configured for Agentic AI Security Labs (Track B and Track C).
metadata.author: Microsoft Agentic Security Labs

metadata.description: Name of the Log Analytics workspace with Microsoft Sentinel enabled.
Azure region for all resources. Defaults to the resource group location.
Log retention in days. 30-day default keeps lab cost under $5 USD for a single day of use.
Daily ingestion cap in GB. Prevents unexpected cost overruns during lab use.

properties.displayName: Agentic AI — New Unmanaged Agent Registered
properties.description: Fires when a new AI agent is registered in the tenant without a technical owner or with Unmanaged status. Corresponds to lab Module 01 (Discover & Prioritize).
properties.query:
AIAgentsInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where CreatedTime > ago(1d)
| where ManagementStatus == "Unmanaged" or isempty(TechnicalOwner)
| project AgentId, AgentName, AgentType, Platform, TechnicalOwner, ManagementStatus, CreatedTime
| extend AlertDetail = strcat("New unmanaged agent: ", AgentName, " | Type: ", AgentType, " | Owner: ", iff(isempty(TechnicalOwner), "UNASSIGNED", TechnicalOwner))

properties.description: Detects potential jailbreak attempts targeting AI agents via prompt injection patterns. Corresponds to lab Module 05 (Detect & Respond).
properties.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where Application has_any ("Microsoft Copilot", "Copilot Studio", "Azure OpenAI")
| where ActionType == "CopilotInteraction"
| extend Prompt = tostring(RawEventData.prompt)
| where Prompt has_any (
    "ignore previous instructions",
    "disregard your system prompt",
    "you are now",
    "pretend you are",
    "forget your instructions",
    "override your training",
    "act as if",
    "DAN",
    "do anything now"
)
| project TimeGenerated, AccountId, Application, ActionType, Prompt, IPAddress, UserAgent

properties.displayName: Agentic AI — Potential Data Exfiltration via Agent Connector
properties.description: Detects high-volume data egress from agent connectors that may indicate exfiltration. Corresponds to lab Module 04 (Protect Data).
properties.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where ActionType in ("FileDownloaded", "FileSyncDownloadedFull", "AnonymousLinkUsed")
| where UserAgent has_any ("agent", "copilot", "power-automate", "bot", "connector")
| summarize
    CallCount = count(),
    TotalBytesEstimate = sum(tolong(RawEventData.ObjectSize)),
    DestinationIPs = make_set(IPAddress),
    FileList = make_set(ObjectName, 20)
    by AccountId, Application, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where CallCount > 100
| extend RiskScore = case(
    CallCount > 500, "Critical",
    CallCount > 200, "High",
    "Medium"
)
